name: UBC Future Global Leaders (on campus)
org: UBC Extended Learning, University of British Columbia
what_you_do: Take a university-style academic course or mini school taught by UBC professors and instructors on the Vancouver campus, with workshops and social activities. You get a letter of completion.
who_can_apply: High school students ages 15 to 18 who have completed grade 10 or equivalent. UBC recommends about a 78% average, 3.5 GPA, B average or IB 5. Students still learning English should have IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 80 or higher. Open to students from other countries.
pay_detail: 2026 fees listed in CAD: course $1,940 for Canadian students (including permanent residents) or $2,620 international; mini school $2,110 Canadian or $2,855 international. Optional residence add-on $2,650. A $500 deposit is due when you register. Fees can change. The President Bursary is for B.C. grade 11 students with financial need.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 sessions: July 5 to 16, July 19 to 30 and Aug 2 to 13, 2027. Residence registration deadlines (noon): May 21, June 4 and June 18, 2027. Commuter deadlines (noon): June 18, July 2 and July 16, 2027. Residence can close sooner if full. The page does not say when 2027 registration opens.
how_to_apply: No application, transcripts or proof of English are needed. Check that you are eligible. Add a course or mini school to your cart. Have a parent or guardian create a Family Account. Pay the deposit at checkout. Then finish the information package within 48 hours.
notes: Costs money, and it is a camp-style university course, not a job. This is in Canada, so British Columbia rules apply and this guide has not checked them. The fee table is labeled 2026 and still shows a 'due May 1, 2026' date next to the 2027 sessions, so check the 2027 fees before you plan. An online version also exists (3 week courses); this card covers the on-campus version.
